what: Plan removes the direct lint-bash32 prerequisite from make lint even though the replacement pre-commit path is not equivalent coverage
scenario_or_breakage: pre-commit run --all-files does not cover untracked files, while scripts/lint-bash32.sh currently enumerates git ls-files --cached --others; a newly created unstaged .sh or .inc.bash with Bash 4 syntax can pass local make lint after this PR even though the current lint target catches it
suggested_fix: Keep lint-bash32 in the lint target for this PR; wire the pre-commit hook for CI and commit-time coverage without changing the broader local make lint contract
